**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The licence analogue for this consortium agreement is the Terminal Station Right of Use (§11) together with the capacity/IRU rights (§12):

- **Duration / revocability** — granted from the RFS Date "for the duration of this Agreement" (§11.1); nothing lets the Terminal Parties revoke at will. The only forfeiture path is capacity reclamation under §23 for non-payment after written notice and a two-month cure window — i.e. uncured material breach, consistent with the preferred position.
- **No extra charges** — §11.2 confirms no charges beyond Capital Costs and O&M.
- **Affiliates** — §22.3(a)–(d) and §22.4 permit assignment of our rights to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate (and another Affiliate of our Parent) without Management Committee consent, subject only to timely written notice under §22.6. That squarely satisfies the fallback and, on successor transfer, the preferred position.
- **Downstream use** — §11.5 extends the right of use to our IRU purchasers; §12.20/§12.22 allow unrestricted IRU sales and commercial use by other Carriers after the expansion/three-year trigger; §17.3 contemplates shared and co-located Direct Access facilities.

Sub-elements short of preferred, noted only: contractors acting on our behalf are not expressly named, and the grant is for the life of the Agreement rather than styled "perpetual and irrevocable" — both normal for a submarine cable consortium and not material enough to redline.
